captions: Tab. 3.2 Unit process raw data of the supply of useful heat from solar thermal systems without considering auxiliary heating
Tab. 3.1 Collector yield, solar net yield, converted solar energy, and auxiliary energy
reason: Tab. 3.2 on p.19 is the 'Unit process raw data of the supply of useful heat from solar thermal systems' — the heat-at-collector datasets, of which the 30 m2 copper flat-plate collector on a multiple-dwelling flat roof for hot water is one column. Tab. 3.1 (p.18) gives the collector and solar net yields that convert the system to a per-MJ heat basis. Tab. 2.1 (p.8) and Tab. 2.9 (p.15) are the construction and disposal of the collector and of the whole system, i.e. the infrastructure inputs to this dataset rather than the dataset itself.
